text: Implemented and verified the Phase 0.3 slice. Added cross-built modules/scenario-testkit shared ScenarioCore (ScenarioStatus, caveats/policies, observations, tolerances, ScenarioResult, generic matrix/vector views) with JVM+JS tests; design and fit retain only typed Mat/DMat/DVec adapters in test scope plus package bridges. Added tools/scenarios/validate_manifest.py as the stdlib-only manifest authority: it rejects duplicate IDs, missing suite/reference paths, unsupported platforms, unknown statuses, empty commands, incomplete external path declarations, unsupported receipt schemas, missing receipt fields, source/receipt disagreement, and stale SHA-256 hashes. The public fixture manifest now declares scalafim-external-fixture/v1; exporter local --check remains external-package-free and validates receipt coherence. Focused gate SCALAFIM_SBT_CACHE_ROOT=/tmp/scalafim-first-level-sbt-p03 COURSIER_CACHE=/tmp/scalafim-first-level-sbt-p03/coursier bash tools/ci/first-level-gate.sh passed scenarioTestkitJVM/JS, hrfJVM/JS, hrfLawsJVM/JS, designJVM/JS, modelJVM/JS, and fitJVM/JS (all suites passed). Negative manifest and stale-receipt checks rejected invalid fixtures. show designJVM/fitJVM Compile dependencyClasspath contains no scenario-testkit or MUnit; test->compile scope and publish/skip preserve production boundaries. No remote CI or external-regeneration receipt is claimed.
